where: Every shop — the Tinderwick General Store, the Pearlmoor Chandlery, the Galehigh Kite-Maker's and every counter after
mood: The Counter Bell — a bouncy little shop tune with a doorbell for a hook; browse as long as you like.
_note: Matches the classic: 116 BPM, 4/4 with a light swing, B-flat major, AABA. The doorbell 'ding-ding' (a bright falling third) is the hook. Small room: four or five instruments, close and dry-ish, brushes only. | Re-roll 1: the first take obeyed 'a little gap the doorbell answers' as stop-time, near-silent for ~1.5 s every two bars; the briefs now keep the bass and pizzicato bouncing under the bell.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
4/4 with a light bouncy swing, a continuous friendly groove that keeps moving
cheerful marimba lead melody, a touch comic
pizzicato strings bouncing on the offbeats
music box and a bright doorbell ding-ding figure as the hook
bouncy plucked sampled bass hopping root and fifth
soft brushes and a little tambourine
small cosy village shop interior, close and intimate, short warm room reverb
strong singable melody, instantly hummable and pleasant on repeat

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {the shop door opens: the doorbell rings its bright ding-ding over the bass and pizzicato already bouncing, and a quick marimba pickup hops straight into the tune}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the bouncy shop tune on marimba in B-flat major, light swing over a steady bouncing bass; at each phrase end the doorbell rings ding-ding while the bass and pizzicato keep hopping}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same tune again with pizzicato strings answering and a music-box sparkle on top, the bass bouncing all the way through, still small and friendly}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: browsing the shelves, a sly tiptoe in E-flat major with staccato pizzicato and a comic little run, the bell rings a question, then it hops home}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the shop tune returns in B-flat major with its doorbell answers; the last bar hops straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
